title: Bittersweet Chocolate and Cocoa Babka Twist
summary: A glossy, twisted loaf marbled with a rich dark chocolate filling, brushed with a light sugar syrup for shine.
equipment: wire rack set in a tray

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
unsalted butter, softened, in pieces (15 g of it for the tin)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk 350 g bread flour and 1½ tsp yeast, add 120 ml milk, 2 eggs, orange zest and 1 tsp vanilla, mix to a dough and rest 15 min.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Add 50 g sugar and ½ tsp salt, knead 5 min, then work in 85 g butter piece by piece until smooth and elastic, 8-10 min.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Rise until doubled, 1-1½ h, then chill for 1 h to firm up.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Melt 225 g chocolate with 115 g butter, stir in 55 g icing sugar, 45 g cocoa and ½ tsp salt, and cool until spreadable.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Roll the dough to a 50 x 30 cm rectangle, spread with the chocolate filling leaving a border, then roll up tightly into a log.

steps.title: Twist
steps.text: Halve the log lengthwise, twist the two halves together with cut sides up and fit into the lined tin.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave until risen 2-3 cm above the rim, 1-1½ h.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 160 °C for 30 min, then tent with foil and bake until the centre reads 93-96 °C, 50-60 min more.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Boil 100 g sugar with 60 ml water for 1-2 min and brush over the hot babka, then cool completely before slicing.

tips: Chill the dough before shaping so it's firm enough to twist neatly without the filling squeezing out.
Check the centre reaches 93-96 °C to be sure the enriched dough is fully baked through.
Brush the syrup on while the babka is still hot so it soaks in rather than sitting on top.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keeps well wrapped at room temperature for a few days, or slice and reheat gently before serving.
